headline: Backup Power Outlook for Smith County
summary: Homes in Smith County face a long outage about once every 3 years. This comes from 8 years of records since 2018. In one storm 56% of homes in the county lost power. In another 33% lost power. One Core lasts about 13 hours in August. One Core lasts about 29 hours in February. Two Cores are suggested for a home with gas heat and a larger footprint. Two Cores cover 81% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
